info.title: Personal Finance Planning Assistant
info.description:
Financial goal simulator. All figures come from a deterministic, tested engine.

**Projections, not advice:** results depend entirely on the assumptions shown with them
and are not guarantees. Amounts are EUR, rates are decimals (`0.05` = 5%).

get.description: Liveness check: the database and the chat's language model.

post.description:
Turn a description ("I take home 2,400 a month…") into a draft of the plan forms, with
the next question. Nothing is saved and the description isn't stored: the person checks
the forms and saves them. Send the returned draft back with the next message.

get.description: What's saved so far. Projections need both your finances and an active goal.
The saved profile and today's position (surplus, savings rate, net worth).
All goals: the active one first, then previous ones, newest first.

post.description:
Create a goal. It becomes the active goal; the previous one is kept, inactive.
The target date must be this month or later, and at most 50 years ahead.

schema.title: Response List Assumption Sets Assumptions Get

put.description: Create or replace the assumption set with this name (e.g. `base`).

post.description:
Project the saved plan from the start of this month, optionally with what-if overrides.
Overrides are never saved.

Run the saved plan (optionally with what-if overrides) over many simulated futures,
with yearly investment returns varying around the assumed return at the profile's
investment risk. The same seed always gives the same result.

Run several scenarios on the saved plan, side by side. The first scenario is the
baseline that the differences are measured from (by default, the current plan).

Simulate the scenarios of the comparison, all on the same futures, so differences come
from the scenarios rather than from luck. The first scenario is the baseline.

get.description: Saved scenario definitions (the built-in ones are not listed).

post.description: Save a scenario definition. A scenario with the same name is replaced.

One conversational turn. The message is turned into a structured request, the
deterministic engine runs it, and the reply explains the result. Nothing is saved:
what-ifs never change the plan. Pass `thread_id` back to continue the conversation.

thread_id.description: Continue a conversation. Omit to start a new one.

GoalDatesOut.title: GoalDatesOut

Dates by which 10%, 50% and 90% of futures have first reached the target. Null when
that share of futures doesn't reach it within the horizon.

target_amount.title: Target Amount

remaining.title: Remaining

fraction.title: Fraction
fraction.description: Share of the target already there, from 0 to 1.

InvestmentRisk.title: InvestmentRisk
InvestmentRisk.description: How widely the portfolio's yearly returns vary (docs/PHASE2_DESIGN.md, 2.3).

assumption_set.title: Assumption Set
assumption_set.description: Only when the user names one; otherwise the default set is used.

Likelihood.title: Likelihood
Likelihood.description:
'How likely am I to reach my goal?', optionally for a what-if ('...if I invest €200
more?'). Answered from simulated futures, never from the model.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: "mock" (no model) or the model name, e.g. "phi3".

available.title: Available
available.description: Whether the model answers. The chat works either way: without a model, rules and templates handle every message.

NeedsClarification.title: NeedsClarification
NeedsClarification.description: Understood partly, but something is missing, e.g. an amount without what it applies to.

monthly_investment_contribution.title: Monthly Investment Contribution
monthly_investment_contribution.description: New monthly contribution. Can't be combined with the delta.

monthly_investment_contribution_delta.title: Monthly Investment Contribution Delta
monthly_investment_contribution_delta.description: Change to the saved monthly contribution, e.g. 200 or -100.

monthly_net_income_delta.title: Monthly Net Income Delta
monthly_net_income_delta.description: Change to monthly take-home pay, e.g. 300 or -200.

monthly_expenses_delta.title: Monthly Expenses Delta
monthly_expenses_delta.description: Change to monthly expenses, e.g. -200 to spend 200 less.

first_year_return.title: First Year Return
first_year_return.description: Return of the first year only, e.g. -0.3 for a 30% market drop.

OverridesIn.title: OverridesIn
OverridesIn.description: Changes relative to the saved plan. Omitted fields keep their saved value.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: How a value was worked out: "€900 + €700".

asked.title: Asked
asked.description: The field the last question was about.

to_check.title: To Check
to_check.description: Fields read by a language model, to be checked before saving.

pending_goal_amount.title: Pending Goal Amount
pending_goal_amount.description: A goal amount worked out from a percentage, waiting for a yes.

PlanDraft.title: PlanDraft
PlanDraft.description:
The forms' values so far. Sent back by the browser with each message (the API keeps
nothing). None means "not known yet"; 0 means "said to be nothing".

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Projections, comparisons and the chat can run.

savings_rate.title: Savings Rate
savings_rate.description: Surplus / income; null when income is 0.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: Profile values as output. No input limits: a what-if may legitimately exceed them.

monthly_net_income.title: Monthly Net Income
monthly_net_income.description: Take-home pay; grows with salary growth.

investment_risk.description: How widely yearly investment returns vary: low 5%, medium 10%, high 15% volatility. Used only by the uncertainty simulation.

position.description: Today's figures, computed from the profile.

annual_inflation.title: Annual Inflation
annual_inflation.description: Displayed only; not used in calculations.

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of futures that have reached the target by then.

assumption_set.title: Assumption Set
assumption_set.description: Only when the user names one; otherwise the default set is used.

RequiredContribution.title: RequiredContribution
